summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — distinct from `evenorides-zacynthus` in Epitome 7.29.

story.text: Apollodorus names Evenorides among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance in the long catalogue of Epitome 7.27, listed after Paralus and before Clytius.
Apollodorus assigns the same patronymic again to Zacynthus in Epitome 7.29 — a homonym hazard; see `evenorides-zacynthus`.
